history.recommendation_text: The Board reiterates that the Administration should take appropriate action to hold the entities accountable in the exercise of their delegated authority to grant exceptions to human resources administration instructions and avoid having entities implement exceptions outside their delegated authority in the future.
history.administration_response: The Administration requests that this recommendation be closed, based on the successful roll-out of a pilot exercise and follow- up with select entities in January 2024. The objective of the pilot is to engage in more depth with some entities in order to support them in improving their performance in relation to exceptions by identifying (a) strategies for the first line of defence to implement and (b) opportunities for improving the support provided by the second line of defence (Business Transformation and Accountability Division and policy and business owners). This pilot exercise has consisted of several meetings with the entities, and follow-up through email and meetings. The feedback and lessons learned from pilot entities have already been collected and the progress in performance (notably in addressing the backlog of cases) documented. Feedback has also been taken into consideration to improve internal monitoring by the Business Transformation and Accountability Division and the monitoring process. Changes are gradually being implemented. In a later stage, the lessons learned from the pilot will be shared with and applied to all entities once the positive impact on performance has been demonstrated.
history.board_assessment: Given that a pilot exercise has been successfully rolled out and there was follow-up with select entities in January 2024, the Board considers this recommendation to be implemented.
